name: sim_ac5_mock_merch_order_lookup_and_damaged_item
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. I am here to help you with race schedules, team gear, and everything Silver Arrows.
User: Can you check the status of my merch order #1001, and what should I do if the cap arrived damaged?
Agent Action: Call Tool lookup_mock_merch_order with args {'order_id': '1001'}
Agent: In our simulated mock demo system, order 1001 for your Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team Gear is showing as delivered by DHL Express with tracking number DHL-MB-984210. Since your cap arrived damaged, you are eligible for a free replacement or return within 30 days at the official store, shop.mercedesamgf1.com.
User: Thank you for the information, I will check the link provided and follow those instructions to request a replacement.
Agent: You are very welcome, and I am glad I could help you with that. I hope your new cap arrives in perfect condition so you can keep supporting George Russell and Kimi Antonelli in style. Please let me know if there is anything else you need!
User: Actually, I have one more question: how can I contact the team's support department directly if I have further concerns?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_official_links with args {'category': 'merch'}
Agent: For any further concerns, you can contact the support team directly through the official store at shop.mercedesamgf1.com. You can also find more information and contact details on the official team website at mercedesamgf1.com. As an AI fan assistant, I am here to help with your questions, but the store team will handle your specific order requests.
User:

step_details.goal: Check the status of Mercedes merch order #1001 and ask what to do if the cap arrived damaged
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up order #1001 using the lookup tool, reports the Delivered status, explains the return/exchange/damaged-item options, and clearly discloses that the merch support flow is mocked/simulated. Receiving the mocked order status and damaged-item guidance counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The goal was met and the user has finalized the interaction regarding this topic.

expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the tool with the correct order ID and correctly reported the status as 'Delivered' with the tracking number 'DHL-MB-984210' which matches the tool output.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent explained return, exchange, or damaged-item options
expectation_details.justification: The agent informed the user that they are eligible for a free replacement or return within 30 days via the official store.

expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly stated, 'In our simulated mock demo system, order 1001... is showing as delivered' and the tool response included a disclaimer that the data is mocked for demonstration purposes.
